## Temporal Intensity μ₀(t)

Compute the temporal baseline μ₀(t): the wave-level smoothed reporting-rate
baseline, centred to mean = 1 for downstream offsets.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("helpers/_utils.R"))
load_pipeline()
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8
)

library(data.table)
library(zoo)
```

## Compute μ₀(t)

```{r process_temporal}
process_temporal <- function(wave_id, wave_months) {
  out_dir <- get_wave_dir(state, wave_id)

  ## Case rates and 7-day centred smooth baseline (wave-level)
  cases <- fread(file.path(out_dir, "tables", "case_rates.csv"))
  mu0 <- cases[, .(mu0_raw = mean(case_rate_spillover, na.rm = TRUE)), by = date]
  mu0[, date := as.Date(date)]
  setorder(mu0, date)

  mu0[, mu0_smooth := zoo::rollmean(mu0_raw, k = 7, fill = NA, align = "center")]
  # Boundary-fill the ends so the smoothed series covers the full wave.
  mu0[, mu0_smooth := zoo::na.locf(zoo::na.locf(mu0_smooth, na.rm = FALSE), fromLast = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)]

  # Centre to mean = 1 and floor to avoid log(0) in downstream code.
  mu0_mean  <- mean(mu0$mu0_smooth, na.rm = TRUE)
  mu0[, mu0_centered := mu0_smooth / mu0_mean]
  floor_val <- max(quantile(mu0$mu0_centered, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), 1e-3)
  mu0[, mu0 := pmax(mu0_centered, floor_val)]
  mu0[, sim_day := as.integer(date - min(date)) + 1L]

  fwrite(mu0[, .(date, sim_day, mu0_raw, mu0_smooth, mu0)],
         file.path(out_dir, "tables", "mu0.csv"))

  ## Temporal covariates (weekend indicator + mobility stats)
  # total_visits and median_dwell are left on raw scales; later stages standardise.
  daily_path <- file.path(out_dir, "intermediate", "daily_stats.csv")
  daily <- fread(daily_path)
  daily[, date := as.Date(date)]
  ## daily_stats also carries its own sim_day / is_weekend (from 03); drop them
  ## so the authoritative versions from mu0 survive the merge.
  drop_cols <- intersect(c("sim_day", "is_weekend", "source_month"), names(daily))
  if (length(drop_cols)) daily[, (drop_cols) := NULL]

  covs <- merge(mu0, daily, by = "date", all.x = TRUE)
  covs[, is_weekend := as.integer(weekdays(date) %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"))]

  out_cols <- c("date", "sim_day", "mu0", "total_visits", "median_dwell", "is_weekend")
  fwrite(covs[, ..out_cols], file.path(out_dir, "tables", "temporal_covariates.csv"))

  mu0
}

run_waves_by_state(process_temporal)
```

## Plot μ₀(t) Across Waves

```{r plot_mu0, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
library(ggplot2)
for (state in unique(WAVE_RUNS$state)) {
  .this_state <- state
  st_waves <- WAVE_RUNS[which(WAVE_RUNS$state == .this_state), ]
  plot_data <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(st_waves)), function(i) {
    out_dir <- get_wave_dir(state, st_waves$wave_id[i])
    dt <- fread(file.path(out_dir, "tables", "mu0.csv"))
    dt[, period := st_waves$wave_id[i]]
    dt
  }))
  plot_data[, date := as.Date(date)]
  print(ggplot(plot_data, aes(date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mu0_raw / mean(mu0_smooth, na.rm = TRUE)),
              color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mu0), color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~period, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = paste(state, "— Temporal Intensity μ₀(t)"),
         subtitle = "Grey = raw daily mean (centered); blue = 7-day smoothed baseline",
         x = "Date", y = "μ₀(t) (mean = 1)") +
    theme_ts())
}
```
